title: Fan Energy System
description: A four-image reference-dependent rollout that locks one fictional team identity across rivalry, crowd, and merch-adjacent social assets.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the club-neutral color system, supporter energy, apparel cues, and poster-like social grammar. Images 02-04 depend on that anchor while pushing rivalry, crowd, and merch-drop expressions of the same team identity.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-rivalry-pulse-tile, 03-home-crowd-poster, 04-merch-drop-variant. Queue may run 02-rivalry-pulse-tile, 03-home-crowd-poster, 04-merch-drop-variant concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
